evidence.quote: Of course, these policies are not within the remit of the Federal Reserve but rather for other policymakers to consider and decide.
As of right now, there has been little evidence of economy-wide job displacement from AI.
Yet there is some evidence that AI may have made job entry harder for young workers in some job categories.
